description.zh: 查询的数据目录名称。您可前往[数据湖控制台](https://dlf.console.aliyun.com/cn-hangzhou/metadata/catalog?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.5a225658pT4Dkr)查看数据目录名称。
description.en: The name of the catalog. To find the catelog name, go to the [Data Lake console](https://dlf.console.aliyun.com/cn-hangzhou/metadata/catalog?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.5a225658pT4Dkr).
The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 100.

description.zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

- 如果**NextToken**为空表示没有下一次查询。
- 如果**NextToken**有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌。
description.en:
The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. Valid values:

- If **NextToken** is empty, no more results are available.

- If **NextToken** has a value, it is the token for the next query.

description.zh: 搜索数据库名称的关键字。
description.en: A keyword to search for database names.

description.zh:

description.en:
The tenant ID.

> Hover over your profile picture in the upper-right corner of the DMS console to obtain the tenant ID. For details, see [View tenant information](~~181330~~).
